function.arguments: {"finding_id": 1, "resolution": "The data contains 48 duplicate patient_id entries, meaning 48 patients were re-tested. The data dictionary specifies that the row with the highest `sample_seq` should be used. This was resolved by deduplicating on `patient_id` using `df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()` to keep only one row per patient, ensuring no double-weighting. This is now reflected in `df_dedup` and used in all subsequent steps."}
function.name: resolve_finding
